title: Choosing the right roof — not just the cheapest — in Magnolia
shortStory: This Magnolia homeowner chose Northvale Roofing for guidance, not the lowest bid. We compared IKO Dynasty and Nordic options, colors, and ventilation upgrades so they could make the best long-term decision. The finished IKO roof completed their renovation.
longStory:
This Magnolia homeowner had recently completed major renovations — including a new backyard and pool — and knew the aging roof was the final piece of the project.

After receiving multiple estimates, they chose Northvale Roofing because we took a consultative approach: explaining IKO shingle options, color choices, ventilation upgrades, and potential insurance savings, instead of simply handing over a price. This project wasn't insurance-related — it was about making the right long-term investment.

The finished IKO roof complemented the home's updated appearance and provided lasting protection.

If you're looking for an honest roofing company in Magnolia, we're here to help.
